title: CIPS local feed cut replicates on fresh seed 4: with fuel regrowth cut at t=1500 in a radius-30 disk around the droplet nearest the centre, the target (89 px) is gone by t=1700 and the disk empties (8 -> 3 -> 1 -> 0), while the 188-217 droplets outside match the fed twin exactly
summary: Ran c23's CIPS world.py (20261025T1845-c23-cips-metabolic-claim) unchanged on fresh seed 4, 256^2, T=2500: a fed run, then a run with fuel regrowth set to 0 from t=1500 in a disk of radius 30 around the droplet nearest the centre at t=1500 (centre 122.4, 129.5, area 89 px; target_s4.json). Measured with the finding's localcut.py, its centre patched to this target. Target area at t=1700/2000/2500: 0/0/0 (fed 88/91/89). Bodies inside the disk: 3/1/0 (fed 8/8/7). Bodies outside: 208/199/188 (fed 209/199/188). Droplets form from near-uniform noise by t~340 (cut30/sheet.png), and the cut disk empties while the surrounding emulsion is unchanged. The radius-17 cut was not repeated.

observations.E: localcut.txt: target 89 -> 0 px by t=1700 (fed 88-91), disk bodies 8 -> 0 by t=2500 (fed 7-8), outside 188-217 identical to fed

seeds_run.result: pass: local cut kills the target and every droplet in the disk; the outside is unchanged

controls_run.E: fed/ (same seed, no cut) against cut30/ (localcut.txt)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed, radius 30 only. The target was chosen by nearest centroid at t=1500 from the fed run's frames.
